data.segment_title: Economy: Stock Market, Credit Crunch / Europe
data.segment_description:
(Studio: Katie Couric)  The market meltdown on Wall Street reported; stock statistics cited.  

(New York: Anthony Mason)  The frantic day at the market reviewed; CBS Poll findings on the view of the condition of the economy cited; details given about retail losses and oil and gasoline prices.  [Raven Securities David HENDERSON†- says people are spooked.]  [Three times, President BUSH&nbsp- says "it will take a while."]  [Philadelphia jeweler Matthew SUBLY†- predicts off Christmas sales.]  [Energy analyst Andy LIPOW†- predicts a price decline for gas.]  Why the economic bailout did not have a calming effect, the concern now in foreign banks and why banks are holding money in this "massive crisis of confidence" discussed.  

(Studio: Katie Couric)  Report introduced.  

(London: Richard Roth)  Meltdown Monday on European markets examined; stock statistics from France, Britain, Germany and Russia cited.  [BGC Partners, Inc. Howard WHEELDON†- says the crisis will get worse in Europe.]  [Seven Instruments Justin Urquhart STEWART†- says they {European banks} "look like cats in a sack."]  

(Studio: Katie Couric)  Report introduced.  

(Washington: Bob Orr)  House hearings demanding Lehman Brothers CEO Richard Fuld explain CEO compensation featured; Lehman internal memo quoted.  [Representative Henry WAXMAN&nbsp- questions CEOs making so much money.]  [FULD&nbsp- comments on the liquidity problem.]  [In response to question from Representative Brian Higgins, FULD&nbsp- denies knowing the document.]  

(Studio: Katie Couric)  Treasury Secretary Henry Paulson's naming of Neil Kashkari† to oversee the new Office of Financial Stability noted.

data.segment_title: Campaign 2008 / Obama vs. McCain / Nasty Campaign
data.segment_description: (Studio: Katie Couric)  The standings of presidential candidates Senators John McCain and Barack Obama in the latest CBS News poll cited.   (Albuquerque: Chicago: Dean Reynolds)  How the campaign is getting nastier with the emphasis on personality over policy featured; McCain and Obama TV ads shown.  [In New Mexico, McCAIN&nbsp- criticizes Obama.]  [In Florida, vice presidential candidate Governor Sarah PALIN&nbsp- says Obama does not seem American like us.]  [October 4, PALIN&nbsp- says Obama "palled around' with terrorists.]  Obama's links to 1960s radical William Ayers in Chicago politics and McCain's link to swindler Charles Keating noted.  [OBAMA&nbsp- says McCain is running out of time.]  Tomorrow's second presidential debate mentioned.   (Studio: Katie Couric, Jeff Greenfield)  How the McCain campaign has stated its need to change topics from the economy to raise doubts about Obama's character and judgment and how negative campaigns may depress voter turnout discussed.   (Studio: Katie Couric)  CBS News coverage of the debate noted.
